When something goes wrong, and the words used

The usual snags and what to do about them, and the words the app uses, in plain language.

When something goes wrong

What it is

No signal. Keep working: everything you enter is saved on the phone first. Pages that keep records in your account (Field log, Weather, Team, Jobs, Sales and money, Land and dues) send what you entered when the phone is back online. Only signing in, the land check and fetching weather need the signal at that moment, and the app says so.

Also inNothing gets lost

What it is

The sign-in code has not come. Wait a minute and check the spam folder. The Send sign-in code button rests for 30 seconds after a code is sent, so a second tap too soon does nothing. Check the email address for a typing slip.

Also inGetting set up

What it is

iPhone and Bluetooth. Safari on iPhone cannot talk to Bluetooth or USB devices. For a Bluetooth scale, open the brew page in the Bluefy browser; probes in the Roast timer need Chrome or Edge on Android or a computer. Typing readings works everywhere.

Also inQuality as you go

What it is

A number in the wrong box. Weights that do not add up are flagged when you save: a basket total that never appears, a step whose Out kg is more than its In kg, a green weight above what the run gave. The app never changes your numbers; it tells you what to check. Open the record, move the number, save. The change is kept beside the record.

Also inKilos carry forwardRecords you can trust

What it is

I cannot find a record. Use Find (on Home or Now): it searches the records on this phone by name, code or word, with no signal needed. A voided record is still found, marked Voided. If you use more than one phone, sign in on both so they see the same records.

Also inFinding your way

What it is

The app looks out of date. New versions arrive by themselves. On Account, App version has Check for updates.

Also inGetting set up

What it is

I changed phones or cleared the browser. Sign in with the same email and the records you kept in the cloud come back. Records that were only on the old phone come back from a backup file through My data, Import. Trails live only on the phone where they were walked, so keep their backup file.

Also inNothing gets lost

What it is

Something is wrong in the app. Every page has Feedback at the bottom: an idea, a problem, a question or thanks. No account needed; leave a contact only if you want a reply.
